states: Before/after pair on pulse-dev: production builds of the parent 03767f1e95 (PR 2723 head) and of this tree, each embedded with go build and run as a DEMO_MODE mock stack (ports 7771/7772, fresh data dirs, telemetry off), driven by the same headless Chromium script.

Both builds, both overviews, both widths: exactly one workload FilterBar on the page (aria-label "Proxmox workload filters" / "vSphere workload filters"), zero filter groups and zero inputs inside [data-testid=workloads-page], zero toolbars with the default "Workloads filters" label or default search placeholder, and the page toolbar precedes the surface in document order.

Search for a guest name narrows the embedded table to that one row (Proxmox artifact-cache-310: 140 to 1 at desktop, 36 to 1 at phone; vSphere etl-batch-01: 18 to 1) and shows Clear filters at desktop; a no-match search shows the surface empty state "No guests found / No guests match your search" and Clear filters restores 140 / 18 rows.
Opening a guest drawer shows the page toolbar "Clear pinned selection" button; clicking it closes the drawer and the button goes away, at both widths on both pages.
Kiosk mode (?kiosk=1, sessionStorage pulse_kiosk_mode=true) shows the same single page toolbar and rows in both builds; only the deleted branch ever read kiosk mode.

Results JSON: 103 of 104 measurements identical, and the toolbar/surface chrome signature (tag, test id, role, aria-label multiset outside tbody) is identical on all four page/width pairs. The one difference is the count of the same demo-mode 403 on POST /api/usage/workload-history at phone width (timing-dependent; identical failing-endpoint set). No page errors in either build.

Dist proof: 188 files each side; 94 byte-identical, 91 differ only in chunk-hash names and SRI strings, 3 differ in code. After normalising hashes and 1-3 character identifiers, Proxmox-*.js and Vmware-*.js lose only suppressFilterToolbar:!0 on the WorkloadsSurface mount, and WorkloadsSurface-*.js loses only the toolbar JSX and its show-condition, the useKioskMode() call and kioskMode state entry, and the defaultSortKey fallbacks. CSS unchanged.

check-bundle-size.mjs passes on both builds: WorkloadsSurface 57.20 kB to 56.81 kB gzip (baseline 61.07, cap 70.23), Proxmox 78.71 to 78.70, Vmware 11.23 to 11.22, total JS 1367.17 to 1366.62 kB; no chunk renamed, .bundlesize.json unchanged.
interactions: Demo sign-in, then for /proxmox/overview and /vmware/overview: wait for guest rows, count toolbars and inputs inside and outside the surface, record the chrome signature, screenshot.

Type the first guest name into the page search, read the row count, then type a no-match term, read the empty state, click Clear filters (or clear the box at phone width) and read the restored row count.
Click the first guest row name cell to open its inline drawer, read the Clear pinned selection button, click it, confirm the drawer closed.
Repeat in a 1440x900 desktop context and a 390x844 touch phone context, then load both overviews with ?kiosk=1 in a fresh context and count toolbars and rows; screenshots of every state inspected.
